result.topic_en: Brief logarithmic calculations for the rotating fluid ellipsoid: a relation between angular velocity and density in terms of an angle ψ, and evaluation of the expression -3 sin 2ψ + 2ψ(2 + cos 2ψ) using logarithms of cos 2ψ and sin 2ψ.

methods.what: Expression relating rotation (angular velocity) to density for the fluid ellipsoid as a function of an angle ψ
Trigonometric expression to be evaluated numerically
Numerical evaluation using common logarithms (log tables, n marking a negative number); log 3 = 0.4771213 added to log sin 2ψ
